Attached: 1 image

Wekan v12.24 brings major workflow improvements to the open-source Kanban board. 

Key additions include new import and export formats for Todoist, OPML, and Org mode. Teams can now sync Scrum planning directly from Jira and GitLab or load database and mail secrets securely from files.

Release details: https://github.com/wekan/wekan/releases/tag/v12.24
Run it easily on PikaPods: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=wekan

#opensource #selfhosted
